candidate: two supports, no front conflict, image distance / diagonal > 0.01, nearest sparse distance / source Z > 0.01; TUM check cells only
assignment: nearest existing leader within radius * min(source Z, leader Z); leader is never moved; no transitive merging
distinct_view_test: nearest member per image; three source images with every pair of camera rays at least 1 degree apart at the leader
sensor_audit: after grouping, compare leader with measured world point of nearest member per source image; distance / measured source Z <= 0.01 and measured point / source Z farther than 0.01 from sparse cloud
training: frozen real RGB reconstructions, unchanged; no point injection
